seo_title: Advertise to dog and cat owners · Najdimo
seo_description: Ads and Vet Partner on Najdimo: reach dog and cat owners in your region. Real numbers, clearly labelled ads, no tracking.
hero_lede: Reach dog and cat owners in your region. Your ad helps keep the search for lost pets free for everyone.
stat_reunions: Pets home again in the last 90 days
pilot_note: We are piloting in Ljubljana. The numbers are real and still small. They grow with every report.
stats_date: As of {datetime}. We refresh the numbers every hour.
stats_source: Figures from our own database, with no personal data.
stats_error: We cannot show the numbers right now. Please try again later.
slot_feed_body: Between reports on the map list, after every eighth report. Never first and never two in a row.
slot_detail_body: On the page of each lost or found animal, below the main actions. A good fit for nearby clinics and shops.
slot_reunited_body: When an owner marks their pet as home again. The happiest moment in the app.
slot_sidebar_body: Next to the content on the website, on larger screens.
format_body: One 4:3 image (at least 1200 × 900 pixels, JPG or PNG up to 500 KB), a title of up to 60 characters, text of up to 120 characters and an https link. We prepare the ad for all four slots.
preview_support_body: Every way home is free. Voluntary contributions cover servers, maps and alerts.
preview_partner_body: Vets, shops and groomers: reach dog and cat owners in your region. Ads are always clearly labelled.
preview_adopt_title: Adopt an animal from a shelter
preview_adopt_body: Dogs and cats in shelters are waiting for a new home. Maybe yours.
targeting_body: We show your ad based on the place and the type of animal in the report, not on who is looking. We do not build user profiles.
vet_lede: For vet practices. Everything that helps an animal home is free for you. Vet Partner adds visibility in your area.
vet_1: A verified clinic profile with opening hours, services, a "24-hour emergency care" badge and a booking or call link.
vet_2: A featured "Vet nearby" placement on lost and found pages in your area.
vet_3: A mention in lost-pet alerts and on posters for your region, always labelled as an ad.
vet_4: A monthly report on views, clicks and pets returned home in your area.
vet_5: A monthly subscription with a VAT invoice. Cancel at any time.
vet_free_body: Reporting found animals brought to you, chip lookup, matches and talking to owners.
trust_2: There are no ads while people report a lost or found animal, in conversations or during payment. People meet you when they have time to look.
trust_3: We count impressions and clicks in aggregate and without cookies. You get a report every month.
pricing_body: During the pilot we share prices for ads and Vet Partner on request. The first partners receive more favourable terms.
step_2: We reply within 2 working days with a proposal for your region.
step_3: Once you approve it, we prepare your ad and start showing it.
form_message_placeholder: For example: a vet practice in Maribor, interested in the report page slot.
form_consent: I agree that Najdimo may contact me about this enquiry.
form_privacy: We only use your details to reply to your enquiry. More in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
err_email: Enter a valid email address, for example name@company.com.
err_message: Write a few words about what you are interested in.
err_message_long: The message is too long: at most 2000 characters.
err_consent: We need your consent to reply.
success_title: Thank you, we have received your enquiry
limited: Several enquiries were sent from this network. Please try again in an hour. Your details are still in the form.
captcha_failed: The check did not work. Your details are still in the form; please try again.
server_error: The enquiry could not be sent. Please try again in a few minutes.
faq_1_a: People who look at reports on Najdimo in the regions and for the animals you choose.
faq_2_a: No. We show ads based on the place and type of animal in the report. We use no tracking cookies and share no data about users.
faq_3_a: We count impressions and clicks per day, slot and region. An impression means the ad was rendered on screen. You get a report every month.
faq_4_q: What do you need from us?
faq_4_a: An image, a short title, some text and a link. We prepare the ad for every slot.
faq_5_a: No. Shelters and municipalities use Najdimo for free, forever.
faq_6_q: Is Vet Partner required for the free features?
faq_6_a: No. Reporting found animals, chip lookup, matches and talking to owners are free for every practice.
